scope: Phase 2 first milestone: fresh quorum and semantic-smoothing recipes; CPU validation only.
intentional_fresh_protocol_choices: Seed 1000 construction uses full pinned Alpaca corpus with source-index offsets, following the prefix pilot.
Exclude the bundled 32 evaluation prompts before candidate sampling using normalized text matching.
Quorum selects every generated source occurrence in source/row order and uses fixed contiguous microbatches of 16.
Semantic comparisons share the newly trained panel; historical archived panel and smoke-prompt bindings are unnecessary.
Semantic validity filtering records its observed retained count instead of requiring the historical outcome 1013.

new_checks: Pinned inputs, sizes, training budgets, smoothing parameters, request counts and complete input bindings.
Build through report with actual component factories and CPU stand-ins for model generation/training.
HF dataset serialization, Cobalt deletion, terminal-marker variants, normalized held-out exclusions.
Interrupted regeneration, verified resumption, retained duplicate source occurrences, changed-input rejection.
Variable semantic retained count, unfiltered quorum outputs, all method reports and whole-output abstentions.

limitations: CPU model stand-ins validate assembly, not stochastic GPU outputs or experimental performance.
Fresh extension configurations still require GPU runtime checks under a separately agreed budget.
Fresh-run connections for subliminal, EM and MASSIVE remain subsequent Phase 2 milestones.
No publication or repository synchronization performed in this milestone.
